N05#1.zh: 高衙内！你调戏我妻子，同时用言语污辱我；我忍受不住了！我一定要把你打得满地找牙才甘心！
N05#1.t: Young Master Gao! You molested my wife and insulted me. I can't stand it any more! I won't be satisfied until I've knocked your teeth all over the ground!

N05#2.zh: 你...你敢打我？你知道打了我会有什么后果吗？
N05#2.t: Y... you dare hit me? Do you know what will happen if you hit me?

N05#3.zh: 我不在乎！我拼着大不了不干这个禁军教头，也要出这口鸟气！
N05#3.t: I don't care! Even if it costs me my post as instructor, I'll vent this rage!

N05#4.zh: 哼哼...你只有一个人，我手下可有数十个人；就算你是禁军教头，你能打倒这么多人吗？
N05#4.t: Heh heh... you're just one man, and I've got dozens. Imperial instructor or not, can you beat this many?

N05#6.zh: 林教头！我们来了！你可不是一个人孤军奋战！
N05#6.t: Instructor Lin! We're here! You're not fighting alone!

N05#9.zh: 有架可以打怎么不通知俺呢？太不够意思了吧！洒家的拳头好久没揍人了！
N05#9.t: There's a fight and nobody told me? That's not very friendly! My fists haven't hit anyone in ages!

N05#10.zh: 林兄弟，你却怕他本官太尉，洒家怕他甚鸟！俺若撞见那撮鸟时，且教他吃洒家三百禅杖了去！
N05#10.t: Brother Lin, you may fear his father the Marshal, but what do I care! If I run into that rat, I'll give him three hundred blows of my staff!

N05#11.zh: 好吧！大家爱怎么打就怎么打吧！不过，高衙内是我的对手，谁都不要出手！
N05#11.t: All right! Fight however you like! But Young Master Gao is mine. Nobody else touch him!

N05#14.zh: 胜利条件   --- 打败高衙内

N05#16.zh: 失败条件二 --- 林冲死亡

N05#18.zh: 限制回合数已到，未完成任务，游戏失败！

N05#19.zh: %N为林冲强出头，反遭杀身之祸，林冲在盛怒之下，失手杀了高衙内，众人连夜逃离东京。流离十数日，终被官兵所擒，押解回京。高俅下令将众好汉刺配边疆，并于押解途中予以杀害........
N05#19.t: %N stood up for Lin Chong and was killed for it. In his rage Lin Chong killed Young Master Gao, and everyone fled Kaifeng that night. After drifting for over ten days they were caught by soldiers and taken back to the capital. Gao Qiu had the heroes exiled to the frontier and murdered on the way........

N05#20.zh: 林冲失手被杀，林夫人闻讯后羞愤自尽；众好汉四散而逃，数日后，相继被高俅所擒，并于押解边疆的途中被害身亡........
N05#20.t: Lin Chong was killed. When Lady Lin heard, she took her own life in shame and grief. The heroes scattered, and within days Gao Qiu had caught them one by one and had them killed on the road into exile........

N05#21.zh: 不好啦，少爷昏死过去啦！
N05#21.t: Oh no, the young master's passed out!

N05#22.zh: 快逃啊！小李，你抬头我抬脚；快把少爷送回府内！
N05#22.t: Run! Little Li, you take his head and I'll take his feet. Get the young master back to the manor!

N05#23.t: Hahaha! That felt good! That felt good!

N05#24.zh: 林兄弟，就这样让他们逃走不要紧吗？
N05#24.t: Brother Lin, is it all right to let them get away like that?

N05#25.zh: 让他们逃吧！反正我已经出了这口怨气，高衙内的伤大概三四个月内不会好，这段期间东京可就平静多了！哈哈哈！对了，你们在东京还没有住处吧！何不去我那里住个几天？
N05#25.t: Let them go! I've vented my anger anyway. Young Master Gao won't heal for three or four months, so Kaifeng will be a lot quieter in the meantime! Hahaha! Oh, you don't have anywhere to stay in Kaifeng yet, do you? Why not stay with me for a few days?

N05#26.zh: “豹子头”大发神威，高衙内自找苦吃。
N05#26.t: The 'Panther Head' shows his might, and Young Master Gao gets what he asked for.
